decisions.reason: The message specifies how clips are delivered for client audit but does not change the client's approval authority, approval criteria, publication eligibility, or rejected-clip rules.
The submission channel and audit purpose do not alter the required completeness, educational value, or standalone comprehension of each clip.
Sharing a Google Drive link in project chat for audit does not change the social-media channels targeted by the finished clips.
The source decision concerns delivery and review logistics and does not modify any background-music requirement.
The source decision does not change whether or how B-roll must support the spoken message.
The first live batch remains a five-clip production deliverable; the message only specifies the separate package and channel used to submit those clips for audit.
The Google Drive submission instruction does not change source material, source-video choice, topic constraints, or moment-selection rules.
The message establishes submission logistics but does not alter the clean-editing or visual-effects standards.
The source decision does not mention or change the required clip duration.
The instruction applies to the current submission exchange and does not modify the earlier initial three-clip trial's count, source content, or acceptance condition.
The delivery and audit instruction does not change caption color, font, or effects requirements.
Submitting clips through Google Drive for audit does not change the established initial Instagram go-live day.
